title: Shipping and delivery
html:
We ship serviced vintage electronics and home goods from 400 N Ashley Dr, Suite 1300, Tampa, FL 33602 to the 48 contiguous United States.

Costs and estimates

Shipping is calculated at checkout for your address and basket, and shown before you pay. We prepare orders in 1-2 business days. After carrier pickup, transit usually takes 3-7 business days, so the estimated total from order to delivery is 4-9 business days. We prepare orders Monday to Friday. Our cut-off is 2 pm ET; later orders enter processing on the next business day.

Packing

Each item is wrapped individually, with screens, lenses and dials cushioned and the parcel double-walled.

Tracking and address corrections

You can follow the shipment through the tracking link in your dispatch email. A label-created notice can appear before the carrier holds the parcel. If the address is wrong, email TwellmanSciuto7665@outlook.com immediately; once the carrier has it, changes depend on the service.

Delays and missing parcels

If we cannot ship by the promised date we will contact you by then with a revised date. You may wait or cancel for a prompt refund. If tracking stops, or shows delivery and you have no parcel, check for a carrier notice and contact TwellmanSciuto7665@outlook.com; we will investigate with the carrier and explain the resolution.

Cross-border charges

We ship within the United States, so no import duty applies. Sales tax we collect is shown at checkout.
